mintAuthority.headline: Supply is collateral-, deposit- or debt-matched; the 3-of-6 manager Safe can still drive interest issuance with no practical ceiling.
mintAuthority.summary: invUSD is issued by a single immutable Monolith V1 Lender on Ethereum. Coin.minter() is a constructor-immutable pointer to that Lender, and Coin, Lender, Vault, InterestModel and Factory are all non-proxy deployments with zero EIP-1967 slots, so no role can authorize another minter or upgrade mint logic. Five paths call coin.mint(), verified from exact-match Sourcify source at Ethereum block 26506036. Borrowers mint against sINV collateral up to the constructor-immutable 65% collateral factor; anyone may mint 1:1 through the in-Lender PSM against USDS held as sUSDS until the immutability deadline on 23 April 2030; pullLocalReserves() is permissionless and mints already-accrued local fees and PSM profit to the operator; pullGlobalReserves() mints already-accrued global fees when called by the V1 Factory; and accrueInterest() mints newly accrued interest to the sInvUSD vault and reserve buckets while adding the full interest to totalPaidDebt without re-running the collateral solvency check. Because the InterestModel borrow rate has a 0.5% floor and no practical ceiling below the uint88 cast, a single manager transaction with no timelock can raise the target free-debt band to 9,500 bps and cut the half-life to 12 hours, placing paid debt on a rising exponential branch that compounds unbounded debt and interest supply even after the immutability deadline freezes the setters. The Lender manager is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 of six EOAs with no timelock, no enabled modules and no guard. Both Lender.operator() and V1 Factory.operator() are the Inverse Finance 2-day Timelock (172,800-second delay, administered by the Inverse Governor), which can set local reserve fees up to 1,000 bps on this V1 Lender, set global Factory fees up to 1,000 bps (currently 0 bps with zero feeRecipient), pull local reserves, replace the manager, transfer operator via two-step pending acceptance or advance the immutability deadline. Conservation at block 26506036 is exact: totalPaidDebt plus totalFreeDebt plus freePsmAssets equals totalSupply plus unpulled accruedLocalReserves (1,239.14 invUSD) to the wei. No prudential supervision or whole-supply attestation applies.

controls.label: Monolith V1 Lender (only Coin minter and in-Lender PSM)
controls.capDescription: No numeric supply cap exists. Four mint paths are gated by collateral, equal USDS deposits or already-accrued reserves: adjust() enforces the immutable 65% sINV collateral factor; buy() requires an equal USDS deposit held as sUSDS before the 2030-04-23 immutability deadline; pullLocalReserves() and pullGlobalReserves() mint only fees and PSM profit already accrued. The fifth path, accrueInterest(), mints newly accrued interest to the sInvUSD vault and reserve buckets and adds the full interest to totalPaidDebt without re-running the collateral solvency check. Because InterestModel has a 0.5% floor and no practical ceiling below the uint88 rate cast, setting a high target free-debt band and 12-hour half-life lets paid debt and minted interest grow far beyond collateral value.

controls.label: invUSD Lender manager Safe (3-of-6, no timelock)
controls.capDescription: The manager Safe cannot mint directly, add a minter, alter the 65% collateral factor, change the oracle feed, pause or upgrade contracts. Before the 2030-04-23 immutability deadline it can immediately set redeemFeeBps up to 500, half-life between 12 hours and 30 days, target free-debt ratio band between 500 and 9,500 bps and maxBorrowDeltaBps between 50 and 200, and it can replace itself at any time with no deadline. Setting the band to 9,500 bps and half-life to 12 hours creates an unbounded interest-issuance lever with no timelock.

controls.label: Inverse Finance 2-day Timelock (Lender and V1 Factory operator)
controls.capDescription: Holds both Lender.operator() and Monolith V1 Factory.operator() behind a 172,800-second delay administered by the Inverse Governor (0xbeccb6bb0aa4ab551966a7e4b97cec74bb359bf6). On the V1 Lender it can set local reserve feeBps up to 1,000 bps (currently 0 bps), invoke all manager setters before 2030-04-23, advance immutabilityDeadline, replace the manager, nominate a pendingOperator and receive minted accruedLocalReserves. On the V1 Factory (0x6d961c9dcf1ad73566822ba4b087892e3839b849) it can set global feeBps or customFeeBps up to 1,000 bps and feeRecipient (both currently zero). It also operates SwitchFeed (0xeca2f329a011a4d464f8ef97e493974964911ed0), DynamicFeeCurveFeed and ChainlinkBasePriceFeed.

Coin.minter() is the immutable Lender and Coin, Lender, Vault, InterestModel and Factory carry zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots. Supply of 534,884.564044059156821072 invUSD plus unpulled accruedLocalReserves 1,239.137612356378285246 equals totalPaidDebt 274,250.939699127464806994 plus totalFreeDebt 2,556.229609264083031379 plus freePsmAssets 259,316.532348023987267945 exactly to the wei. Immutability deadline is 2030-04-23T10:22:47Z (1903172567). Because accrueInterest() re-runs no solvency check and the borrow rate has no practical ceiling below uint88, the manager Safe's half-life and target-band setters create an unbounded debt-and-interest issuance lever, keeping economicCapSemantics unbounded and posture unbounded-adverse. Reconciliation is not applicable to an on-chain CDP with no off-chain reserve report, and no prudential supervisor exists.
